name: Crumbl Sugar Cookies
desc: Thick almond sugar cookies under pink almond icing, served chilled.

source.title: Copycat Crumbl Chilled Sugar Cookies
source.evidence: Identical ingredient list and amounts (1 cup salted butter, 1/2 tsp almond extract, 3 cups flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 3 cups powdered sugar icing with neon pink coloring) and the same 1/4 cup portions.

ingredients.raw: 4 drops neon pink gel food coloring (optional)
ingredients.item: drops neon pink gel food coloring

steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and line baking sheets with parchment paper.
Cream the butter and sugar with a mixer until light and fluffy, 2-3 minutes.
Scrape the bowl, add the eggs, vanilla and almond extract, and beat until mixed.
Scrape the bowl again, add the flour and baking powder, and mix until thoroughly combined.
Scoop 1/4 cup portions of dough and roll into balls. Flatten each by pressing the bottom of a drinking glass or measuring cup gently into the center.
Place 6 cookies per pan; they spread.
Bake 9-11 minutes, until the centers have puffed and are no longer glossy. Let cool on the pan.
Icing: while the cookies cool, beat the butter until smooth. Slowly add the powdered sugar, almond extract and milk, beating until smooth and creamy. Tint with the food coloring, if using.
Spread the icing on the cookies while they are still slightly warm so it melts into a smooth finish.
Once completely cool, refrigerate at least 30 minutes. Serve chilled.
